findings.title: Runtime-generated origin risk is accepted by source-truth approval
findings.detail: 400 draft phrases originate from runtime_generated source graph refs, but the approved source-truth artifact accepts this risk for the clean EN/RU/UK draft.

requiredBeforeFrenchGeneration: Review and approve the canonical source draft or reject it in favor of another source-truth strategy.
If approved, create a production apply plan that extracts a non-generated source file for lessons 9-16.
Rerun source graph, source graph quality, generated source-truth, reconciliation, canonical draft, validator and readiness gates.
notes: The draft intentionally omits Spanish runtime fields and keeps only EN/RU/UK source material plus English word tokens.
The draft does not modify app files.
Structurally clean does not mean approved source truth.
